heading: INT. TWENTY-SECOND FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM, SYNERGEX CORP - DAY

units.text: INT. TWENTY-SECOND FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM, SYNERGEX CORP - DAY
A glass-walled room with a view of a parking structure the CEO insists on calling "the skyline."
A laminated sign reads: THIS IS A SAFE SPACE FOR RADICAL CANDOR.
CHIP HALLORAN-TSENG (40s, quarter-zip, laser pointer) presides at the head of the table.
Beside him, a flip chart with a single word on it: SYNERGY.

Around the table sit DAHLIA OKORO (30s, analyst, perfect posture), BERNARD "BUZZ" KOWALSKI (50s, thirty years in accounting, cardigan) and PRIYA NANDAKUMAR (20s, intern, notebook open to a blank page).
Chip circles the room, laser dot dancing across the ceiling tile.
Dahlia writes a note and crosses it out.
Buzz unwraps a butterscotch.
Priya's pen hovers over her notebook.
Okay, team. Radical candor. Dahlia, what's one thing you'd change about how we work?
units.name: CHIP

units.text: Honestly, Chip? Meetings.
units.name: DAHLIA

units.text: Love that. Candid. Buzz?
units.name: CHIP

units.text: Meetings.
units.name: BUZZ

units.text: We're hearing a lot of meetings. Priya, you're new, fresh eyes.
units.name: CHIP

units.text: Um. I don't know. Maybe the meetings?
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: Okay. So the through-line, and I want to be sensitive here, is some of you feel there may be a perception of too many meetings.
units.name: CHIP

units.text: Buzz stands, walks to the window, and stares at the parking structure.
Dahlia takes the laser pointer from Chip's hand while he is mid-gesture and sets it on the table.
Priya's pen has started to write, small, tight letters.
Chip blinks at his empty hand.
Chip, we've had this meeting four times.
units.name: DAHLIA

units.text: Dahlia, I appreciate that, and I'm going to park that.
units.name: CHIP

units.text: Park it where? There's no parking. It's a parking structure and there is no parking.
units.name: BUZZ

units.text: Buzz.
units.name: CHIP

units.text: I have been here thirty years, Chip. I have given you eleven reports on how to fix the parking. You have given me a mug.
units.name: BUZZ

units.text: We value you.
units.name: CHIP

units.text: It has a motivational otter on it.
units.name: BUZZ

units.text: I like the otter.
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: Everyone looks at her.
She shrinks, then, to her own surprise, does not.
But I also think this meeting is eating the whole day and nobody's doing the work. Sorry. Radical candor.
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: Silence.
Chip lifts the cap off a marker, caps it, uncaps it.
Dahlia leans back.
Buzz turns from the window with his arms folded and a look of dawning joy.
Chip, she's right.
units.name: BUZZ

units.text: Priya, I hear you, and the thing with candor--
units.name: CHIP

units.text: Chip.
units.name: DAHLIA

units.text: --is it needs a framework--
units.name: CHIP

units.text: Chip.
units.name: BUZZ

units.text: --and a safe space!
units.name: CHIP

units.text: He slaps the flip chart.
It topples.
SYNERGY lands face-down on the carpet.
Priya, Buzz and Dahlia look at it, then at him.
He looks at it too.
He straightens his quarter-zip.
Let's circle back.
units.name: CHIP

units.text: Dahlia stands.
Buzz unwraps another butterscotch and offers Priya one.
She takes it.
They file out in a line, and Chip is left alone with the otter mug and a view of the garage.
